info.title: egov-hrms
info.description:
eGov DIGIT Human Resource Management System (HRMS) service. Manages employee records, their linked egov-user accounts, jurisdictions, assignments, service history, education, departmental tests, documents, deactivation and reactivation.

**Authentication:** this service has no separate `Authorization` header scheme. Every request carries its auth context inside the JSON body's `RequestInfo` object: `RequestInfo.authToken` is the Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's OAuth login (`/user/oauth/token` or `/user/_login`), and `RequestInfo.userInfo` carries the caller's identity and roles (`userInfo.roles[].code`). Endpoints validate/authorize purely from this embedded object; there is no token in any HTTP header.

tags.name: Employee
tags.description: Employee lifecycle: create, update, search, count.

post.description: Creates one or more Employee records (each with an embedded egov-user account). Performs duplicate checks (mobile number / username), validates MDMS-driven codes (employeeType, department, designation, role, qualification, stream, departmental test) and data-sanity checks (exactly one current assignment, non-overlapping assignment/service periods, dates not before date of birth, etc.) before persisting. On success, creates the corresponding user(s) in egov-user and returns the created Employees with server-generated id/uuid/auditDetails.

post.description: Updates one or more existing Employee records. Each Employee must include its existing id, uuid and (unchanged) code; the service looks up the existing record(s) by uuid and enforces that previously-created jurisdictions, assignments, service history, education, departmental tests, documents and deactivation details are not removed (only appended to / modified). Setting isActive=false requires deactivationDetails with a reasonForDeactivation validated against MDMS and an effectiveFrom equal to the current date; reactivating (isActive=true with reActivateEmployee=true) requires reactivationDetails whose effectiveFrom falls between the prior deactivation date and now. Also propagates changes to the corresponding user in egov-user.

post.description: Searches employees by any combination of the query parameters below. The JSON request body carries only a RequestInfo (search criteria travel as query parameters, bound via @ModelAttribute). If no criteria at all are supplied (an 'open search'), the caller's RequestInfo.userInfo.roles must include one of the roles configured as open-search-enabled, otherwise a 400 is returned. CITIZEN-type users may not search by `ids`. Passing `asOnDate` requires `departments`+`designations`; passing `roles`, `phone` or `names` requires `tenantId`.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Filter by employee/user name(s). Requires tenantId to also be supplied.

parameters.name: asOnDate
parameters.description: Epoch millis. When supplied, at least one department and one designation must also be supplied.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Filter by role code(s). Requires tenantId to also be supplied.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filter by employee numeric id(s). Not permitted for CITIZEN-type requesters.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant id. Mandatory when searching by phone, names, or roles.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Filter by the employee's user mobile number. Requires tenantId to also be supplied.

200.description: OK - list of employees matching the criteria (possibly empty).

400.description: Bad Request - invalid search combination, e.g. an open search from a non-privileged role, `ids` used by a CITIZEN-type caller, `asOnDate` without both departments and designations, or `roles`/`phone`/`names` supplied without `tenantId`.

RequestInfoRole.description: A single role held by the requesting user, as embedded in RequestInfo.userInfo.roles.

UserInfo.description: Identity of the calling user, embedded inside RequestInfo. Together with RequestInfo.authToken this is the sole authentication/authorization mechanism used by this service -- there is no separate Authorization header.

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT request envelope. AUTHENTICATION NOTE: this service has no separate `Authorization` header scheme -- the caller's Bearer JWT (obtained via egov-user's /user/oauth/token or /user/_login) is carried as `authToken`, alongside the caller's identity in `userInfo`. All eGov-HRMS endpoints authenticate/authorize purely from this embedded RequestInfo.

authToken.description: Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's OAuth login (/user/oauth/token or /user/_login). This field is the auth carrier for the whole request -- there is no separate Authorization header.

ErrorRes.description: Default error body produced by egov-tracer for any CustomException raised in this service (e.g. by EmployeeValidator). Returned with HTTP 400 unless otherwise noted.

RequestInfoWrapper.description: Envelope carrying only a RequestInfo, used as the JSON body of the employee search API (search criteria itself is passed as query parameters).

GuardianRelation.description: Relationship of the employee to the guardian named in User.fatherOrHusbandName.

EmployeeDocumentReferenceType.description: Which part of the Employee record a document is attached to.

HrmsRole.description: A role assigned to the employee's user account (org.egov.hrms.model.Role), validated against MDMS master data (common-masters.Role) on create/update.

User.description: The egov-user account backing an Employee. Created/updated in egov-user by this service as part of employee create/update.

gender.description: Free-form in the DTO; conventionally one of MALE, FEMALE, OTHERS.

type.description: Free-form in the DTO; conventionally one of EMPLOYEE, CITIZEN, SYSTEM.

Jurisdiction.description: A single administrative-hierarchy assignment for the employee (e.g. REVENUE hierarchy at the amritsar boundary).

Assignment.description: A single posting/assignment held by the employee. Exactly one assignment per employee must have isCurrentAssignment=true, and assignment periods must not overlap.

toDate.description: Must be null for the current assignment, required for past assignments.

ServiceHistory.description: A single service-period record for the employee. At most one entry may have isCurrentPosition=true.

DeactivationDetails.description: Required whenever an employee is deactivated (isActive set to false); effectiveFrom must be the current date.

ReactivationDetails.description: Provided when a previously deactivated employee is reactivated (isActive=true and reActivateEmployee=true); effectiveFrom must fall between the deactivation date and the current date.

Employee.description: A single employee record together with its embedded egov-user account, jurisdictions, assignments and history.

code.description: Employee code / username; immutable once set.

EmployeeCountResponse.description: Ad-hoc map returned by the /_count endpoint (not a strongly-typed DTO in the service).
